additional_info.subject: RE: ID0441237-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP/R6 170002084] Screen is black CRM:02889000349
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
I hope this email finds you well.
Regarding the issue of HMI black screen problem, Please check the following below:
Check for any loose connections to the screen and board.
Update the Dlogic firmware, if its not done in past.
Check for the 24VDC supply to the Dlogic board(PH2).
Verify if the DP cables have been changed in the past with this charger. If not, we suggest replacing them with new DP cables.
If the still persists after all the verification we suggest you in replacing the control panel with generation2. Please find the below MLFB number for the same
8EM5903-0AA03-8AA7 -PH6 Controlpanel DLogic Gen2 CCR Cutout
AC Charging = No Credit Card Terminal = Worldline Valina OR Castles Seitatech OR Castles, Neftis ,Additionally, one sealing 8EM5905-0AA00-8AA.
Please validate it before ordering.

If the height is not correct, then I assume you ordered a Dlogic without the adaptation set. Is this correct?
For now, you should always order the RAFI display, as you mentioned in the note, you already know the correct MLFB, please order it and replace the HMI.
To send the part back for reimbursement, please align with Karsten Gebauer as it doesn't fall under the Tech Support responsibilities.
Since we have a solution, can I close the ticket or do I send it back to your regional queue?
Thanks a lot!
Best regards,
Francisco
